newsitem.title: USA: Mortgage-backed firmer ahead of wage report.
newsitem.headline: Mortgage-backed firmer ahead of wage report.

text.p: Mortgage-backed securities were firmer ahead of the second-quarter employment cost index due out early Tuesday.
The ECI is expected to show a gain of 0.8 percent in the second quarter, after a 0.6 percent rise in the first quarter, according to a Reuters poll.

Participants agreed that business in MBS was quiet today but late in the session thirty-year discount coupons were 7/32 to 9/32 firmer, while premium coupons were 5/32 to 10/32 firmer. In the 15-year sector, 6.0 percent coupons were up between 6/32 and 7/32 and 8.5 percent coupons were 2/32 to 4/32 firmer.
